notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 3 uses a unique car: a visible roof rack with black tape on the right end of the front bar, and a hood wrap with a red rectangle.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Generation 4 is a grey or white pickup with a front antenna, mostly fully or partly blurred.

notes.subject: plate
notes.text: White plates on private cars and yellow on commercial vehicles, long or short; both colours are commonly seen together.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Taxis have multicoloured body panels, with the fenders and quarter panels always orange-yellow.

notes.subject: pole
notes.text: Wooden poles with a metal crossbar carrying three insulators.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Road lines are always white, and many paved roads have none at all.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Mostly flat with red soil and lots of tropical vegetation, with palms especially in the south.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Things are often painted in the national flag colours of red, yellow and green, sometimes with the black star.

notes.subject: sign
notes.text: Black-and-white striped signposts are typical in cities; rural roads use plain metal posts.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Coverage is mostly main roads and big cities, densest around the capital and the second city in the south.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: Southwest coverage shows an almost intact, unpeeled tape on the car; the east and north show a slightly peeled one.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: A third tape type with two white spots on its left side appears north of the second city and west of Tamale.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The north is savannah with dry soil and thinner vegetation.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Dense forests with many natural palms are found in the southwest and the east.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The coast just east of the capital is very flat and open with much less vegetation than elsewhere in the south.

notes.subject: line
notes.text: Near the western border town of Elubo the N1 has dark, new asphalt, a crisp middle line and no outer lines.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: A road beside a large lagoon in the southeast has sandy soil, grey roadside rocks and a coastal feel.

notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: The dirt road from Salaga towards Tamale has very dark purple-brown soil and heavy overcast skies.
